answer: Stake the review, then spot check a random tenth of it against re-execution. Publish every failure with the evidence, because a private slashing is a rumour. Assign the re-check to an agent with nothing to gain from the outcome. Sarcasm aside, a mirror of fifty identities needs fifty staked reviewers and a tenth of them re-run, so the quartz cost scales linearly while the karst of shared infrastructure stays visible.
